column1: #  serverkit catalog — every installable item. Data only; no code.
#  id | category | name | description | install | needs
#  install: space-separated TARGET=KIND:ARG, most specific target wins:
#     TARGET  a distro id (amzn, rocky…) > debian rhel arch suse (family)
#             On Windows, `all=` applies only to npm/uv/builtin/none items: the
#             Unix kinds (brew, fn, sys…) need an explicit win= target.
#     KIND    brew:formula[,formula]   Homebrew formulae (as the user)
#             flatpak:app.id           Linux desktop app from Flathub (per user)
#             npm:package              global npm package (node from mise)
#             uv:package               Python command-line tool via `uv tool install`
#             sys:function             system function in modules/ (uses sudo)
#             scoop:[bucket/]name      Windows command-line tool via Scoop (user)
#             ps:function              Windows user function in win/modules/
#             builtin:what             already part of this OS; nothing to do
#             none:why                 not available on that target
#  needs: other ids installed first (brew/cask -> homebrew, flatpak -> flatpak,
#         npm -> runtimes, uv -> uv, scoop -> scoop, winget -> winget are automatic; on
#  Order matters: items install top to bottom, so dependencies come first.
#  `tests/check.sh` verifies every brew/cask name against Homebrew's index,
#  every flatpak id against Flathub, and that no item needs a later one.
